scripts.build: npm run build -w @todo/contracts && npm run build -w @todo/common && npm run build -w @todo/account-service && npm run build -w @todo/gateway && npm run build -w @todo/todo-service
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @todo/contracts && npm run build -w @todo/common
scripts.test: npm run test -w @todo/contracts && npm run test -w @todo/common && npm run test -w @todo/account-service && npm run test -w @todo/gateway && npm run test -w @todo/todo-service && npm run test:operations
scripts.ops:dlq: docker compose exec -T -e DLQ_OPERATOR_ID account-service node apps/account-service/scripts/dlq-operations.mjs
scripts.replay:history: docker compose exec -T -e TODO_EVENT_REPLAY_OPERATOR_ID todo-service node apps/todo-service/scripts/replay-event.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.verify:account-lifecycle: npm run test -w @todo/account-service -- src/modules/account/deletion/__tests__/account-deletion.repository.test.ts src/worker/__tests__/account-deletion.worker.test.ts src/retention/__tests__/cleanup.repository.test.ts && npm run test -w @todo/todo-service -- src/account-deletion/__tests__/account-deletion.repository.test.ts
scripts.rebuild:chain-projection: docker compose exec -T todo-service npm run rebuild:chain-projection -w @todo/todo-service
scripts.verify:authorization: npm run clean -w @todo/contracts && npm run build -w @todo/contracts && npm run test -w @todo/contracts && node scripts/verify-authorization-docs.mjs
